headline: BGB deployed in 11 flood-hit districts to provide aid
summary: Border Guard Bangladesh personnel are moving into affected areas to support rescue and relief operations in several districts.
details: Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has been deployed across 11 districts currently affected by devastating floods.
The deployment aims to assist local administrations in rescue operations and the distribution of relief materials to stranded residents.
BGB personnel are working to ensure the safety of people in submerged areas and provide emergency support to those in need.
This move comes as several districts continue to struggle with rising water levels and severe flooding.
caption:
